name: Productbird – AI Product Descriptions for WooCommerce
author: Productbird

sections.description:
Stop spending hours writing product descriptions. We are in the era of AI, so why not let it do the heavy lifting?

Productbird is a smart and minimal AI solution for WooCommerce store owners who want to create conversion-focused product descriptions at scale. It analyzes your product images, understands materials, colors, styles, and details, then crafts tailored descriptions that feel human and drive sales.

🚀 Give us a shot?

  • Image Based AI Generation: Our AI doesn’t just write based on some product info. Instead it analyzes product images to understand every detail before writing an accurate description.
  • Built for Conversion: Descriptions designed specifically to increase sales and improve SEO rankings
  • WooCommerce Native: Seamless integration with your existing WooCommerce workflow
  • Bulk Processing: Generate hundreds of descriptions in minutes, not days
  • No Monthly Fees: Pay-per-use credit system, so you only pay for what you need and credits never expire. Get started at app.productbird.ai

✨ Key Features:

  • AI Product Description Generation: Create unique, engaging product descriptions in 1 click
  • Bulk Action Support: Generate descriptions for up to 250 products simultaneously in 3 clicks
  • Smart Product Analysis: AI analyzes product images, categories, attributes, and existing data for accurate descriptions
  • Customizable Tone & Style: Configure tone and formality to match your brand voice
  • Flexible Application Modes: Choose between Manual Review (carefully review each description before applying) or YOLO Mode (auto-apply for those who dare)
  • Progress Tracking: “AI Desc.” column in product list shows generation status at a glance
  • Advanced Filtering: Filter products by “No description” or “AI generated” for better inventory management
  • One-Click Integration: Set up in minutes with a simple API key. Start your free trial at app.productbird.ai
  • Credit-Based Pricing: No subscriptions, credits never expire, use when you need them.

🎯 Perfect For:

  • E-commerce store owners tired of writing product descriptions
  • Businesses scaling their product catalog quickly
  • Stores with hundreds or thousands of products
  • Agencies writing and offering product descriptions as an extra service to their clients
  • Anyone wanting to improve conversion rates with better product content
  • SEO focused merchants looking to rank higher on Google

🌟 Trusted by Growing WooCommerce Brands:

Join successful e-commerce stores already using Productbird to streamline their content creation and boost conversions.

One of our users runs big furniture store and generated 2500 product descriptions in about 30 minutes.

Get Started Today:
Start with 100 free credits. No credit card required. Experience the magic of AI generated product descriptions that actually work. Sign up now at app.productbird.ai

🔒 Data Privacy & Security:

To provide AI-powered features, this plugin securely transmits specific product data (product name, categories, SKU, attributes, image URLs, store name, and store URL) to the Productbird service. Your API key ensures secure communication. No personal customer data or sensitive site information is transmitted.

Additionally, the plugin may collect optional telemetry data about your hosting environment and technical setup to help us improve the service. This telemetry includes non-sensitive technical information such as server specifications and plugin performance metrics. No privacy-related data, customer information, or sales data is ever collected through telemetry. You can opt out of telemetry collection at any time in the plugin settings.

View our complete Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions for full details.
sections.installation:
Quick Setup (5 minutes):

  1. Install: Upload the productbird folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly from WordPress admin
  2. Activate: Enable the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure: Navigate to “Productbird” in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Connect: Enter your Productbird API key and webhook secret (get yours free at app.productbird.ai)
  5. Customize: Set your preferred settings.
  6. Generate: Use the bulk action dropdown on your WooCommerce products page and find “✱ Productbird”

Need an API Key?
Visit app.productbird.ai to create your free account and get 100 credits to start generating descriptions immediately.
sections.faq:
Is Productbird free to start?

Yes! You get 100 free credits when you sign up – no credit card required. With 100 credits you can generate 20 high-quality product descriptions (5 credits per description), giving you plenty of opportunity to test our AI and see the results before investing in additional credits.

How does the AI generate descriptions from images?

Our advanced AI computer vision technology analyzes your product images to identify materials, colors, styles, textures, and other visual details. It then combines this visual understanding with your product data (title, categories, attributes) to create accurate, compelling descriptions.

Do I need a Productbird account and API key?

Yes, the AI generation features require a connection to the Productbird service through an API key from your free account. Get started with 100 free credits at app.productbird.ai

What product data is sent to Productbird?

Only essential product information is transmitted: product name, categories, SKU, attributes, image URLs, and store details. No customer data, personal information, or sensitive site data is ever sent. Full details in our Privacy Policy.

Are there monthly subscription fees?

No! Productbird uses a credit-based system. You only pay for what you use, when you use it. Credits never expire, and you can purchase more anytime. No recurring monthly charges. Start with 100 free credits – sign up now

Can I customize the writing style and tone?

Absolutely! Configure tone, formality level, and other preferences in the settings to match your brand voice perfectly.

How many products can I process at once?

You can select and generate descriptions for multiple products simultaneously using WooCommerce bulk actions.

Will this work with my theme and other plugins?

Yes! Productbird integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce and works with any WordPress theme or WooCommerce compatible plugins. It simply adds content to your existing product description fields.

Can I edit the AI generated descriptions?

Of course! Generated descriptions are added to your standard WooCommerce product description field, where you can edit, modify, or enhance them as needed.

What are Manual Review and YOLO modes?

Productbird gives you complete control over how descriptions are applied to your products:

Manual Review Mode: Perfect for established stores with existing descriptions. Each AI-generated description is presented for your review before being applied. You can approve, edit, or reject each one individually – your existing descriptions are never automatically overwritten.

YOLO Mode: Ideal for new stores or bulk operations where you want to move fast. Descriptions are automatically applied without manual review. This is perfect when you’re starting fresh with hundreds of products that need descriptions quickly.

You choose the mode that fits your workflow – we never force changes to your product descriptions without your control.

Is there customer support available?

Yes! We provide comprehensive support to help you get the most out of Productbird. Contact us through your Productbird dashboard at app.productbird.ai or visit productbird.ai for assistance.
